name: Germany

subjectOf.text: The German KapMuG does not relieve trial judges of deciding the legal issues in every individual case, so it remains administratively burdensome even though its model case judgment binds the trial courts.
subjectOf.abstract: The KapMuG, how- ever, does not discharge the trial judges from addressing the legal issues in each and every case individually.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Richard W. Painter, Forum Competition and Choice of Law Competition in Securities Law after Morrison v. National Austral (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2029983
scope_conditions: German model case proceedings for capital markets claims

subjectOf.text: Under German law the decisive factor in classifying a token is which rights are associated with it; labels such as participation token, utility token, or payment token give only initial guidance and cannot be relied upon outside a comprehensive and binding regulatory classification.
subjectOf.abstract: A prior classification of the token (i.e. as a "participation token", "utility token", or "payment token") can provide initial guidance as to the type of token it is under German law, but is not to be relied upon outside a comprehensive and binding regulatory classification.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3117224

subjectOf.text: BaFin applies substance over form, so transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented reward units risk classification as crypto-assets or financial instruments in Germany, potentially triggering licensing obligations such as crypto custody or proprietary trading.
subjectOf.abstract: BaFin applies substance-over-form. This means that transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented reward units risk classification as crypto-assets/financial instruments, potentially implicating licensing (e.g., crypto custody, proprietary trading).
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: reward units that are transferable, tradable, or profit-oriented
